name: PTB Diagnostic ECG Database
description: The PTB Diagnostic ECG Database is a foundational clinical electrocardiography repository compiled by the National Metrology Institute of Germany (Physikalisch-Technische Bundesanstalt - PTB). It contains 549 high-resolution records from 290 subjects (209 men and 81 women, aged 17 to 87), encompassing healthy volunteers and patients across nine major clinical diagnostic categories: myocardial infarction, cardiomyopathy, heart failure, bundle branch block, dysrhythmia, myocardial hypertrophy, valvular heart disease, and myocarditis. Each record contains 15 simultaneously recorded signals (the 12 standard leads plus 3 orthogonal Frank XYZ leads) sampled at 1,000 Hz with 16-bit resolution. Users should note that this collection is the original 1995 PTB diagnostic database, distinct from the larger 2020 PTB-XL database.
